summary: scripts/st-test runs the checks that do not build (typescript-client, genie-freshness) alongside linux-gate instead of after it, so they no longer add their minutes to every dev-box run

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: The commands, notes and summary are unchanged; the light checks' output now follows linux-gate's. ST_EVIDENCE_SERIAL=1 runs every check one after another as before.

recovery.detail: Set ST_EVIDENCE_SERIAL=1, or revert this change.
